propositions: Shared pytest snapshot teardown fixture recursively descends tmp_path via Path.rglob, which caches entries and does not suppress FileNotFoundError when canonical tracker lock directories disappear mid-traversal on Python 3.11.
Lock lifecycle intentionally creates and removes .ticket-write.lock.d directories; concurrent release during parent scandir triggers vanished-child traversal failure on Python 3.11 but not 3.12.
Path factory calls in conftest.py and snapshot.py consult live os.name during test teardown; monkeypatched os.name='nt' causes WindowsPath instantiation failure on POSIX in Python 3.11.
Teardown must recursively discover and remove .rebar/run_snapshots roots while tolerating only FileNotFoundError for concurrently vanished entries and re-raising all other walk errors.
Repair replaces Path.rglob with os.walk(onerror=...) to tolerate concurrent disappearance, and stabilizes Path construction to match tmp_path flavor instead of consulting ambient os.name.
